# awscc_ssm_ops_item (Resource)

Resource schema for AWS::SSM::OpsItem.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) The description of the OpsItem.
- `source` (String) The origin of the OpsItem.
- `title` (String) The title of the OpsItem.

### Optional

- `category` (String) The category of the OpsItem.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the OpsItem.
- `severity` (String) The severity of the OpsItem.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags for the OpsItem. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String) The user who created the OpsItem.
- `created_time` (String) The time the OpsItem was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_by` (String) The user who last modified the OpsItem.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The time the OpsItem was last modified.
- `ops_item_arn` (String) The ARN of the OpsItem.
- `ops_item_id` (String) The ID of the OpsItem.
- `ops_item_type` (String) The type of OpsItem.
- `status` (String) The status of the OpsItem.
- `version` (String) The version of the OpsItem.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ssm_ops_item.example
  identity = {
    ops_item_arn = "ops_item_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `ops_item_arn` (String) The ARN of the OpsItem

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ssm_ops_item.example
  id = "ops_item_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ssm_ops_item.example "ops_item_arn"
```
